tarea: Personal data inventory and basic GDPR (RGPD) review for a small business

excluye: any system the client has not authorized in writing

reglas: Do not invent data: whatever is not known is marked as PENDING VERIFICATION
Do not draft clauses or privacy policies ready to publish
Always separate legal obligation from recommended good practice
Mark with HUMAN REVIEW everything involving minors, health, biometrics, or cameras

aviso.texto: This report is a technical starting point, not legal advice. Before signing data processor agreements or publishing policies, have it reviewed by a lawyer or a data protection consultant.
